text:
sam (PM): Quick check — I uploaded the GA acceptance checklist: https://intra.redwood/ga-checklist. Need owners for SLA language, monitoring alerts, runbooks, pricing footnotes. Who can claim what?

mira (SRE): I'll own SLOs + alert rules. Two asks: clarify hosted vs dedicated targets, and agree fallback/steer policy when model errors spike.

dino (Product): Product will accept slightly relaxed p99 for long-context models if we record the tradeoffs in the docs and show numbers from pilot. We also need a brief comms line for Sales about Dedicated SLAs.

nora (Sales): Need a one-liner: prospective customers ask "what SLA do you promise for Dedicated?" Something like: "Dedicated deployments include contractual SLAs; pricing & credits by agreement." That keeps it safe.

abby (Docs): I'll produce the public GA readiness page + the internal runbook. I need the exact alert expressions and CLI snippet for rollback/fallback. Can SRE paste examples? ETA Fri.

mira (SRE): Placeholder SLOs to review:
```yaml
hosted:
  availability: 99.95%
  latency_p99: <=350ms
dedicated:
  availability: 99.9%
  latency_p99: <=500ms
```
Also: error-budget policy -> when burned >50% in 1h, auto-steer to reserve pool and page oncall. Will add promql examples to runbook.

sam (PM): Sounding good. Who owns the credit calc + legal wording?

nora (Sales): I'll draft customer-facing sentence + internal formula. Legal needs to sign off on credits and cap.

legal-bot: Please include credit cap, exclusions (force majeure), and a revocation clause. Legal review required before any public SLA statement.

mira (SRE): Proposed alert examples (placeholders):
```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05
```
And: automated policy event when error_budget_burned_percent > 50 for 10m -> traffic_shift{policy="fallback"}.

abby (Docs): Perfect, paste those into the runbook. Also need the API call to trigger fallback or the CLI example.

mira (SRE): CLI snippet (example):
```bash
redwood traffic shift --policy fallback --model default --to model-small --reason "error_budget_burned"
```
I'll add exact args to the runbook.

dino (Product): Launch criteria: Product signs off on GA if: docs published (public + internal), oncall rota staffed for GA week, SLOs documented, and provisional pricing page with footnote for Dedicated/private. Premium SLA lane is post-GA.

nora (Sales): Agreed. That one-liner is OK for now. We'll escalate pricing lanes after GA.

sam (PM): Action list:
- mira: finalize SLO doc + promql alert rules + CLI examples 00 Thu EOD (1870086400)
- abby: publish GA readiness doc + runbook draft 00 Fri (1870172800)
- nora: draft customer SLA sentence + internal credit calc 00 Mon (1870259200)
- dino: decide gating for premium SLA (post-GA vs pilot) 00 Mon (1870259200)
- oncall-bot: confirm GA-week rota & handoff 00 Thu (1870086400)

mira (SRE): I'll also run a staging rehearsal for the traffic steer during burnin so we can validate the rollback path.

abby (Docs): Once draft is ready I'll ping #eng-oncall for review.

oncall-bot: GA-week rota confirmed; backup rotations assigned.

sam (PM): Please add any unresolved blockers to the checklist. If no major objections by Thu EOD we'll mark "Ready for greenlight" and schedule the readout. :white_check_mark:

mira (SRE): ack.

dino (Product): ack.

nora (Sales): ack.

abby (Docs): ack.
